environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in shared VPC with task role arn:aws:iam::112233445566:role/notification-svc-role. Role has ses:SendEmail, s3:GetObject, and broad ec2:Describe* permissions. No permission boundary attached. Container runs as root with default seccomp profile. ALB forwards all traffic on /graphql without request inspection. No egress filtering on the task security group.

config.network: public ALB, no WAF, unrestricted egress
config.container: root user, default seccomp, no read-only filesystem
